title: Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI for predicting neoadjuvant therapy response from breast cancer biopsies
one_line_judgement: 值得先保存：据摘要（arXiv 2610.03693）：Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI 用 8,742 pa…
one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.03693）：Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI 用 8,742 patients across 32 cancer types 学 'histopathology → transcriptome' 第一阶段，corroborated by pathologist review + spatial agreement；第二阶段用 inferred expression + clinical 预测 pCR（neoadjuvant therapy response）。是 llm-evaluation × multimodal-agent 的'two-stage multi-modal AI with cross-modal supervision'长尾跨域应用资产——'learn modality A from modality B to predict modality C target'范式可迁移到其他 scarce-labeled medical AI（pathology + omics）、遥感（光学 + SAR）等领域。今日维持长尾卡片并设置 21 天复盘周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 cross-modal 监督协议、pCR 评测指标、跨 cancer type 验证、与现有 pCR baseline 对照。
